about: Effect-script icon and colour comments (src/props/look.ts, core/src/library.rs look): `list` is what the library list shows (the script's own, else its first effect's); `effects` each effect's own with the script's filling in. Both checkers read this table.

cases.name: no look lines
cases.text:
effect a:
  wait for trig1
  out1 = on

cases.name: header directly on top of the first effect is that effect's
cases.text:
# The prop.
# icon: splat
# color: red
effect fire:
  wait for trig1
  sleep 1

# icon: drop
# color: blue
effect prime:
  wait for trig2
  sleep 1

cases.name: script defaults apart from the first effect
cases.text:
# icon: skull
# color: purple

# icon: ghost
effect one:
  wait for trig1
effect two:
  wait for trig2

cases.name: hex colour, case and spacing
cases.text:
#Icon :  Bat   # night
#  COLOUR=#C00000

effect Porch  Light:
  wait for trig1

cases.name: short hex; a bad hex is no colour
cases.text:
# color: #f80

# color: #12345

  wait for trig1
